description: This file contains tests for the channels command, focusing on runtime error reporting for Signal and iMessage channels. It uses testing utilities and mocks to verify error output formatting.

methods.name: collectStatusIssues
methods.description: Collects status issues for the signal plugin from the last error.

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets or clears the active plugin registry for testing context.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a plugin registry for testing purposes with specified plugins.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base test plugin for channel testing with specified id.

methods.name: formatGatewayChannelsStatusLines
methods.description: Formats the channel status lines for display, including error messages.
